newsitem.title: USA: Lifeway buys building, expands production.
newsitem.headline: Lifeway buys building, expands production.

text.p: Lifeway Foods Inc said Friday it acquired for $1.3 million a 46,000-square-foot building near its existing plant that will allow it to expand production of fermented dairy beverage kefir, farmers cheese and new fat-free versions of its brands.

At its current sales of $5 million to $6 million, the company has nearly reached the production capacity of its existing facilities. The new facility will provide for an increase in incremental capacity of up to $30 million.
Lifeway will finance the purchase through existing cash reserves and already-secured mortgage financing.
